summary:
All 11 bench commands completed successfully. Results:

- Trial 8, write-tests: ON=63022, OFF=57598, ratio=1.094, both solved
- Trial 8, rate-limiter-strategy: ON=312731, OFF=163449, ratio=1.913, ON solved / OFF unsolved
- Trial 9 (11 scenarios): KB-required 100% ON / 0% OFF solve; KB-neutral 100%/100%
- Trial 10 (11 scenarios): KB-required 100% ON / 0% OFF solve; KB-neutral 100%/100%
- Trial 11 (11 scenarios): KB-required 100% ON / 33% OFF solve; KB-neutral 100%/100%
- Trial 12 (11 scenarios): KB-required 100% ON / 0% OFF solve; KB-neutral 100%/100%
- Trial 13 (11 scenarios): KB-required 100% ON / 50% OFF solve; KB-neutral 100%/100%
- Trial 14 (11 scenarios): KB-required 100% ON / 33% OFF solve; KB-neutral 100%/100%
- Trial 15 (11 scenarios): KB-required 100% ON / 50% OFF solve; KB-neutral 100%/100%
- Trial 16 (11 scenarios): KB-required 100% ON / 50% OFF solve; KB-neutral 100%/100%
- Trial 17 (11 scenarios): KB-required 100% ON / 33% OFF solve; KB-neutral 100%/100%

All results appended to bench/economy/results.jsonl and bench/suite/results.jsonl. No failures. KB-required scenarios consistently show ON arm solving 100% while OFF arm fails 50-100% of the time, confirming KB value. KB-neutral scenarios show persistent ON overhead (~33k-67k tok-eq per scenario).

Big-N bench complete. Trials 8-17, all 11 scenarios, 159 total result entries in bench/economy/results.jsonl. KB-neutral (8 scenarios, ~10 clean pairs each): ON arm costs 1.2-2.8× OFF, mean ~1.78×. KB-required: task-transcript OFF 0% solve rate across all trials; rate-limiter-strategy OFF consistently fails 1/13 test; cache-eviction-policy OFF solves ~70% but at 2-5× the token cost. Results firm the paper claim that KB gate routing matters: pay ~1.8× overhead only when KB is needed.
